assets.title: Rail Inspection Trolley
assets.description: Original static four-wheel inspection trolley with editable treads, inner flanges, hubs, axles, hangers, deck, toolbox and push handle. Tread centers X=+/-0.54 m match 1.00 m clear rail gauge with 0.08 m rail heads; axles run X. Origin at flange bottom; tread bottom is 0.04 m above it. Visual game asset, not engineering or simulation.

assets.title: Rail Maintenance Stop
assets.description: Original static inspection stop with two complete 2 m rail modules and matching flanged-wheel trolley. Four tread bottom faces bear exactly on rail-head top faces, independently verified by surface points and opposite normals; no buried wheels. Game visual asset only.

assets.title: Two Meter Straight Track
assets.description: Original 2.0 m repeat-length straight track. Clear gauge between inner rail-head faces is 1.00 m; rail-head centers X=+/-0.54 m, head width 0.08 m and top Z=0.20 m. Four sleepers support separate rail feet, webs and heads. Complete instances repeat along Y.

assets.title: S01 Static Railway Buffer Stop
assets.description: Original static railway end-buffer visual prop with two rail-head mounting shoes at X plus/minus 0.54 m, triangular rear bracing, cross beam and two fixed charcoal pads. Local Z=0 is the rail-head mounting plane, not terrain: place at Z=0.20 m on the original straight-track rail heads. Actual opposing surface contacts are verified in the use-board evidence. Fixed editable parts only; no impact absorption, collision simulation or railway safety specification.

assets.title: S01 Two-metre Railway Side Platform
assets.description: Original static two-metre railway side platform with two recessed concrete piers, full slab, separate light track-edge coping and rear steel railing. Platform top is 0.77 m above its actual ground plane; Y is the 2 m repeat direction. Intended placement X=1.25 m beside the original 1 m clear-gauge straight track leaves 70 mm between pier and sleeper envelopes and 84 mm between coping and inspection-trolley body envelopes. These are static visual placement measurements, not accessibility, loading, passenger-safety or engineering specifications. Editable fixed source and GLB components; no movement claim.

assets.title: S01 Open Railway Flatbed Wagon
assets.description: Original static low railway flatbed wagon with three broad longitudinal freight deck boards, visible supporting underframe, two fixed transverse axles, four independent tread and inner-flange groups, restrained low end rails and fixed coupling blocks. Same rail interface as the existing inspection trolley: tread centers X plus/minus .54 m, local flange bottom Z=0 and tread bottom Z=.04 m; place at Z=.16 m on the original rail head top Z=.20 m. Deck top then reaches .77 m. Actual fixed-pose support, platform side clearance and stopped buffer gap are checked from imported GLBs. Editable fixed source and GLB components only; no wheel animation, dynamic coupling, running, load or railway safety specification.

assets.title: S01 Static Railway Service Signal
assets.description: Original static low-poly railway service signal visual with compact concrete plinth, fixed mast, two unlit recessed colored lens faces and open-front hoods. Height approximately 1.76 m. Editable fixed source and GLB components; lenses have no emissive output or animation. Intended as a game visual marker only: no operational signal aspects, regulatory compliance, real railway safety function, electrical system, or load specification. Actual ground root and clear placement outside existing sleeper and vehicle envelopes are checked from imported geometry.
